status: Source inconsistencies and qualifications remain visible; no outside correction supplied

items.issue: The source reports 36 generalities and 34 intendancies in different contexts; do not silently equate the figures.
The October date associated with Lafayette differs internally (5 versus 4 October). Preserve the source-based event sequence without silently normalizing the inconsistency.
Dom Gerle’s motion is dated April 12 in one passage and April 13 in another.
Retain the source’s November 3 Church-property vote date as a source statement.
Assignat legal-tender dating differs between April 1790 and April 1793 passages. Page 265 comparison is a lead referral; this shard does not claim its independent source review.
The Saint-Cloud excursion is not proved an escape attempt; intentions beyond Montmédy and precise Varennes plans remain qualified.
Robespierre’s early republicanism remains uncertain; denunciation of slavery is not a fully specified abolition programme.
The celebrated revolt/Revolution exchange may be apocryphal.
